HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about National integration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say National integration never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat National integration as rumours only.
   C. Explain National integration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing National integration.

2. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Avoiding all community work

3. Which statement about Modern Nationalism in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Modern Nationalism in Africa as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Modern Nationalism in Africa.
   C. Explain Modern Nationalism in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Modern Nationalism in Africa never happens in Kenya.

4. Which statement about Colonization of Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Colonization of Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Colonization of Africa as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Colonization of Africa.
   D. Explain Colonization of Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Hide all money underground

6. Which statement about Establishment of colonial rule is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Establishment of colonial rule with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Establishment of colonial rule as rumours only.
   C. Say Establishment of colonial rule never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Establishment of colonial rule.

7. Which statement about Human Developments in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Human Developments in Africa.
   B. Treat Human Developments in Africa as rumours only.
   C. Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Human Developments in Africa never happens in Kenya.

8. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

9. Which statement about Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence as rumours only.
   B. Explain Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence.

10. Which statement about African Civilisations up to 19th Century is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain African Civilisations up to 19th Century with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say African Civilisations up to 19th Century never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing African Civilisations up to 19th Century.
   D. Treat African Civilisations up to 19th Century as rumours only.

11. Which statement about Global Wars is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Global Wars as rumours only.
   B. Explain Global Wars with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Global Wars.
   D. Say Global Wars never happens in Kenya.

12. Which statement about Introduction to History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Introduction to History and Citizenship as rumours only.
   B. Explain Introduction to History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to History and Citizenship.
   D. Say Introduction to History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Equity and non- discrimination and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to History and Citizenship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Linguistic groups in Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Establishment of colonial rule and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

1. C — Explain National integration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. B — Obeying laws and caring for public property

3. C — Explain Modern Nationalism in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. D — Explain Colonization of Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. A — Plan income and spending wisely

6. A — Explain Establishment of colonial rule with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. C — Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. D — Explain symbols used on a map

9. B — Explain Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. A — Explain African Civilisations up to 19th Century with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. B — Explain Global Wars with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. B — Explain Introduction to History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Equity and non- discrimination; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Introduction to History and Citizenship; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Linguistic groups in Kenya; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Establishment of colonial rule; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
